tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and every panel interior. Knockout boxes over screentone and focus lines are paper too.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: code block body, inputs, table header row, info card label column. Never a second page colour.

tokens.name: tone-1
tokens.usage: Light screentone dots and flat light gray: hover sweeps, table stripes, empty difficulty pips. Ink text stays legible on it (14:1 / 12.8:1).

tokens.name: tone-2
tokens.usage: Dense screentone dots, hairlines inside panels, disabled borders. Never text.

tokens.name: tone-3
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: empty stars, icon strokes at rest, the TOC rail. 3.5:1 on paper (4.7:1 in Ink). Not for body text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, dates, captions, code comments, punctuation) on paper, paper-2 and tone-1 — 5.8:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, panel borders, solid badges. On paper 17.9:1 (17.1:1 in Ink).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Spot colour 1, vermilion ink. Active states, the one key highlight per page, the flag stamp, insane difficulty, terminal prompt. As text on paper 4.95:1 (6.0:1 in Ink). Deepened from the proposed #E63322, which only reaches 4.1:1 — swap freely, but keep it ≥4.5:1 on paper if it carries small text.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a red fill (insane badge, active filter count). 4.95:1 in Paper, 6.0:1 in Ink.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Spot colour 2, electric blue. Links and string literals in code. On paper 4.9:1, on paper-2 4.55:1 (7.1:1 / 6.5:1 in Ink).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, 2px paper gap. ≥3:1 on paper, paper-2, ink and the terminal ground in both themes.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal block ground — an inverted panel, so shell sessions never read as source code.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Typed commands on term-bg (16.7:1 / 18.6:1).

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Command output on term-bg (8.3:1 / 8.4:1).

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xxl
styles.usage: Impact numerals only: the 404 panel. Clamp to 112px on phones.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero title. Clamp to 48px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Writeup title and page titles (Posts, Events, Tags). Clamp to 40px on phones.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Article h1 inside the body, section titles (Pinned, Files).

styles.name: display-xs
styles.usage: Article h3, card titles, info card values that are words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and panel tabs, set uppercase: event name over a card, INFO / FILES / FLAG tabs, badge text.

styles.name: body-article
styles.sample: The notes endpoint deserialises the mood cookie before checking the session.
styles.usage: Writeup and about body copy. 17px under 640px. Measure capped at 68ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: hacking sh*t - CTF Player, CS student based in Bordeaux
styles.usage: Default UI copy, taglines, descriptions on cards.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card meta lines, table cells, search result context.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav items, buttons, filter buttons, pills.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Fig. 2 — the Snuffleupagus rule that blocks it
styles.usage: Image captions, footer line, field labels in the info card.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Fenced code, terminal blocks and the source-file viewer. Ligatures off.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside body text; inherits the line height of its paragraph.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Dates, file sizes, counts, kbd hints, EN / FR markers, code block language label.

styles.name: flag
styles.usage: The captured flag in the flag panel only. 16px on phones; breaks anywhere.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills and badges, between tag pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding-x (small), list row gap, panel gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel gutter (the white gap between panels), page side margin on phones, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, code block padding, gap between meta rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between article blocks (code, tables, images), page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Before article h2, between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections (header → info card → body).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top padding, space before the flag panel and footer.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: The breath under the home hero on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: panels, buttons, cards, badges, inputs. Manga panels are square.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Only kbd keys and inline code, so they read as small objects inside text.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Difficulty pips and the TOC dot. Never containers.

stroke.note: Ink weights. Panels are drawn, not shadowed: every container is a border in ink at one of these weights.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules inside a panel (table rows, info card rows), easy difficulty stamp, input rest state.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, tags, code blocks, focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-panel
tokens.usage: Major panels: info card, avatar frame, search panel, header bottom rule.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Climax panels only: the flag panel and the 404 impact frame.

tone.note: Screentone geometry. The dot patterns themselves are radial-gradients in bundle.css (--tone-light, --tone-mid, --tone-dense) painted with the tone-1 / tone-2 / ink colours.

tokens.name: tone-pitch-fine
tokens.usage: Dense screentone: hard difficulty, active pill hover.

tokens.name: tone-pitch
tokens.usage: Default screentone: card hover sweep, medium difficulty, panel tab fills.

tokens.name: tone-pitch-coarse
tokens.usage: Large areas: hero panel, cover image placeholder, 404 ground.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header height (52px on phones). Anchor scroll offset = this + space-6.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: Max content width inside the page margins.

tokens.name: size-article
tokens.usage: Writeup body column (≈68ch of body-article).

tokens.name: size-toc
tokens.usage: Sticky TOC column on desktop (≥1100px).

motion.note: Animate only transform, opacity, clip-path and filter. Every transition and keyframe uses these names; prefers-reduced-motion collapses them to dur-fast crossfades.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Impact frames on press, copy stamp hit.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover in/out, focus, pill and button state changes; every reduced-motion crossfade.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Card screentone sweep, dropdown and search panel drop, TOC marker slide, filter indicator.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Heading ink reveals, card entrance reveals, lightbox zoom, flag reveal.

tokens.name: dur-page
tokens.usage: Cross-document panel-cut transition.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay step between siblings in an entrance (cards, search results); cap at 8 steps.

tokens.name: ease-ink
tokens.usage: Entrances and settles: ink lands fast and spreads slowly. Default for reveals, drops, slides.

tokens.name: ease-cut
tokens.usage: Panel cuts: page transitions and the lightbox frame — a decisive in-out.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: closing search, lightbox, dropdown.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Nav dropdown and the phone menu panel.

tokens.name: z-search
tokens.usage: Search panel and its backdrop.

tokens.name: z-lightbox
tokens.usage: Image lightbox.
